name: TAF Inpatient Claims Header File
description: The TAF Inpatient Claims Header file contains claim-level records for inpatient hospital services billed to Medicaid. Each record represents one inpatient claim and includes admission/discharge information, diagnosis codes, DRG assignments, and claim payment totals. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Claims Header
description: Claim-level inpatient records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF). Each row represents one inpatient facility claim submitted to Medicaid, containing header-level information including patient identifiers, admission and discharge dates, principal and secondary diagnoses, DRG codes, and total payment amounts.

content.bene_id: String: BENE_ID. Encrypted CCW beneficiary identifier assigned to uniquely identify an individual across CCW files.
content.msis_id: String: MSIS_ID. State beneficiary identifier used in T-MSIS claims files.
content.state_cd: String: STATE_CD. Two-letter postal abbreviation for the state that submitted the TAF claim.
content.submitting_state: String: SUBMTG_STATE_CD. Numeric state/entity code for the U.S. state, territory, District of Columbia, or related submitting entity that submitted the data.
content.clm_id: String: CLM_ID. Unique CCW claim identifier used to link header, line, and related claim records.
content.clm_num_orig: String: CLM_NUM_ORIG. Original claim identifier assigned by the state payment system.
content.clm_num_adj: String: CLM_NUM_ADJ. Adjustment claim identifier assigned by the state payment system for an adjustment claim tied to an original transaction.
content.clm_type_cd: String: CLM_TYPE_CD. Code indicating the kind of payment or record represented by the claim, such as fee-for-service, capitation, encounter, service tracking, or supplemental payment.
content.bill_type_cd: String: BILL_TYPE_CD. UB-04 bill type code classifying the claim by facility type, type of care, and billing sequence.
content.crossover_clm_ind: String: CROSSOVER_CLM_IND. Indicator showing whether Medicare paid a portion of the claim.
content.adjust_cd: String: ADJUST_CD. Claim adjustment code indicating the type of adjustment record.
content.adjust_rsn_cd: String: ADJUST_RSN_CD. Claim adjustment reason code explaining why the claim was paid differently than billed.
content.adjdctn_dt: Date32[day]: ADJDCTN_DT. Date on which the state made the final adjudication on the payment status of the claim or processed the encounter record.
content.mdcd_pd_dt: Date32[day]: MDCD_PD_DT. Date Medicaid paid the claim.
content.split_clm_ind: String: SPLIT_CLM_IND. Indicator identifying whether the claim was split across records.
content.cll_cnt: Float64: CLL_CNT. Original claim line count as recorded by the state on submission.
content.cll_cnt_calc: Float64: CLL_CNT_CALC. Calculated number of claim lines in the TAF, including denied lines.
content.srvc_trkng_type_cd: String: SRVC_TRKNG_TYPE_CD. Service tracking type code for service tracking claims.
content.ptnt_dschrg_stus_cd: String: PTNT_DSCHRG_STUS_CD. Patient status as of the ending date of service.
content.birth_wt: Float64: BIRTH_WT. Birth weight in grams for newborns on the claim.
content.pgm_type_cd: String: PGM_TYPE_CD. Program type code associated with the claim.
content.mc_plan_id: String: MC_PLAN_ID. State-assigned managed care plan identification number for non-fee-for-service encounters or related claims.
content.wvr_type_cd: String: WVR_TYPE_CD. Code specifying the waiver type under which the beneficiary is covered or the claim is submitted.
content.wvr_id: String: WVR_ID. Federal waiver identifier associated with the claim.
content.othr_insrnc_ind: String: OTHR_INSRNC_IND. Indicator showing whether the insured is covered by another insurance plan other than Medicare or Medicaid.
content.sect_1115A_demo_ind: String: SECT_1115A_DEMO_IND. Indicator for Section 1115A demonstration-related claim context.
content.srvc_bgn_dt: Date32[day]: SRVC_BGN_DT. Beginning date of service covered by the claim.
content.srvc_end_dt: Date32[day]: SRVC_END_DT. Ending date of service covered by the claim; required partitioning field in the RIF.
content.srvc_end_dt_cd: String: SRVC_END_DT_CD. Derived code identifying the date field used to populate SRVC_END_DT.
content.hosp_type_cd: String: HOSP_TYPE_CD. Hospital type code indicating the type of hospital on the claim.
content.admsn_type_cd: String: ADMSN_TYPE_CD. Admission type code indicating the basic type and priority of the inpatient admission.
content.admsn_dt: Date32[day]: ADMSN_DT. Date on which the recipient was admitted to the hospital.
content.admsn_hr: String: ADMSN_HR. Hour of hospital admission using a 24-hour clock.
content.dschrg_dt: Date32[day]: DSCHRG_DT. Date on which the recipient was discharged from the hospital or facility.
content.dschrg_hr: String: DSCHRG_HR. Hour of discharge using a 24-hour clock.
content.admtg_dgns_cd: String: ADMTG_DGNS_CD. ICD diagnosis code provided at the time of admission.
content.admtg_dgns_vrsn_cd: String: ADMTG_DGNS_VRSN_CD. Code identifying the diagnosis coding system used for the admitting diagnosis, such as ICD-9 or ICD-10.
content.primary_diagnosis: String: DGNS_CD_1. Primary diagnosis code on the claim.
content.diagnoses: List[String]: DGNS_CD_1-12. Diagnosis code array corresponding to the claim diagnosis fields.
content.dgns_vrsn_cds: List[String]: DGNS_VRSN_CD_1-12. Diagnosis version code array identifying the coding system used for each diagnosis field.
content.dgns_poa_inds: List[String]: DGNS_POA_IND_1-12. Present-on-admission indicator array for diagnosis fields on the claim.
content.hac_ind: String: HAC_IND. Indicator related to hospital-acquired condition status on the claim.
content.ip_mh_dgns_ind: String: IP_MH_DGNS_IND. Derived indicator identifying whether diagnosis codes on the inpatient claim are related to mental health care.
content.ip_sud_dgns_ind: String: IP_SUD_DGNS_IND. Derived indicator identifying whether diagnosis codes on the inpatient claim are related to substance use disorder care.
content.drg_cd: String: DRG_CD. Diagnosis-related group code for the inpatient claim.
content.drg_cd_sys: String: DRG_CD_SYS. Code identifying the DRG coding system used on the claim.
content.drg_desc: String: DRG_DESC. Description of the DRG assigned to the claim.
content.mdc_cd: String: MDC_CD. Major diagnostic category code grouping diagnoses into broad clinical categories.
content.prcdr_cd_dts: List[String]: PRCDR_CD_DT_1-6. Procedure date array corresponding to procedure code fields on the claim.
content.procedures: List[String]: PRCDR_CD_1-6. Procedure code array corresponding to the claim procedure fields.
content.prcdr_cd_sys: List[String]: PRCDR_CD_SYS_1-6. Procedure coding system array identifying the code system used for each procedure field.
content.admtg_prvdr_id: String: ADMTG_PRVDR_ID. State-assigned provider identifier for the admitting provider.
content.admtg_prvdr_npi: String: ADMTG_PRVDR_NPI. National Provider Identifier of the admitting provider.
content.admtg_prvdr_txnmy_cd: String: ADMTG_PRVDR_TXNMY_CD. Taxonomy code for the admitting provider.
content.admtg_prvdr_type_cd: String: ADMTG_PRVDR_TYPE_CD. Type code describing the admitting provider.
content.admtg_prvdr_spclty_cd: String: ADMTG_PRVDR_SPCLTY_CD. Specialty code for the admitting provider.
content.blg_prvdr_id: String: BLG_PRVDR_ID. State-assigned identifier for the billing provider.
content.blg_prvdr_npi: String: BLG_PRVDR_NPI. National Provider Identifier of the billing provider.
content.blg_prvdr_txnmy_cd: String: BLG_PRVDR_TXNMY_CD. Taxonomy code for the billing provider.
content.blg_prvdr_type_cd: String: BLG_PRVDR_TYPE_CD. Type code describing the billing provider entity.
content.blg_prvdr_spclty_cd: String: BLG_PRVDR_SPCLTY_CD. Specialty code for the billing provider.
content.rfrg_prvdr_id: String: RFRG_PRVDR_ID. Referring provider identification number.
content.rfrg_prvdr_npi: String: RFRG_PRVDR_NPI. National Provider Identifier of the referring provider.
content.rfrg_prvdr_type_cd: String: RFRG_PRVDR_TYPE_CD. Type code describing the referring provider.
content.rfrg_prvdr_spclty_cd: String: RFRG_PRVDR_SPCLTY_CD. Specialty code for the referring provider.
content.prvdr_lctn_cd: String: PRVDR_LCTN_CD. Provider location code on the claim.
content.brdr_state_ind: String: BRDR_STATE_IND. Indicator showing whether services were received across state borders.
content.ip_mh_txnmy_ind: String: IP_MH_TXNMY_IND. Derived indicator identifying whether billing or servicing provider taxonomy on the inpatient claim is related to mental health care.
content.ip_sud_txnmy_ind: String: IP_SUD_TXNMY_IND. Derived indicator identifying whether provider taxonomy on the inpatient claim is related to substance use disorder care.
content.ncvrd_days: Float64: NCVRD_DAYS. Number of inpatient days on the claim not covered by Medicaid.
content.cvrd_days: Float64: CVRD_DAYS. Number of inpatient days covered by Medicaid on the claim.
content.outlier_days: Float64: OUTLIER_DAYS. Number of outlier days associated with the claim.
content.outlier_type_cd: String: OUTLIER_TYPE_CD. Code identifying the type of outlier on the claim.
content.drg_outlier_amt: Float64: DRG_OUTLIER_AMT. DRG outlier payment amount on the claim.
content.fixd_pymt_ind: String: FIXD_PYMT_IND. Indicator for fixed payment treatment on the claim.
content.srvc_trkng_pymt_amt: Float64: SRVC_TRKNG_PYMT_AMT. Service tracking payment amount on the claim.
content.drg_rltv_wt: Float64: DRG_RLTV_WT. Relative weight associated with the DRG on the claim.
content.pymt_lvl_ind: String: PYMT_LVL_IND. Indicator showing whether payment or allowed amount is determined at the header level or line level.
content.billed_amt: Float64: BILLED_AMT. Total amount billed for the claim at the header level.
content.ncvrd_chrg_amt: Float64: NCVRD_CHRG_AMT. Non-covered charge amount on the claim.
content.mdcd_alowd_amt: Float64: MDCD_ALOWD_AMT. Total Medicaid allowed amount for the claim.
content.mdcd_pd_amt: Float64: MDCD_PD_AMT. Total Medicaid paid amount on the claim.
content.mdcd_copay_amt: Float64: MDCD_COPAY_AMT. Medicaid copayment amount on the claim.
content.mdcd_dsh_pd_amt: Float64: MDCD_DSH_PD_AMT. Medicaid disproportionate share hospital payment amount on the claim.
content.mdcr_pd_amt: Float64: MDCR_PD_AMT. Medicare paid amount on the claim.
content.mdcr_ddctbl_pd_amt: Float64: MDCR_DDCTBL_PD_AMT. Medicare deductible paid amount on the claim.
content.mdcr_coinsrnc_pd_amt: Float64: MDCR_COINSRNC_PD_AMT. Medicare coinsurance paid amount on the claim.
content.mdcr_cmbnd_ddctbl_ind: String: MDCR_CMBND_DDCTBL_IND. Indicator related to combined Medicare deductible treatment on the claim.
content.mdcr_reimbrsmt_type_cd: String: MDCR_REIMBRSMT_TYPE_CD. Medicare reimbursement type code.
content.copay_wvd_ind: String: COPAY_WVD_IND. Indicator showing whether the provider waived the beneficiary copay.
content.tp_pd_amt: Float64: TP_PD_AMT. Third-party paid amount on the claim.
content.tp_coinsrnc_pd_amt: Float64: TP_COINSRNC_PD_AMT. Third-party coinsurance paid amount on the claim.
content.tp_copay_pd_amt: Float64: TP_COPAY_PD_AMT. Third-party copayment paid amount on the claim.
content.othr_insrnc_pd_amt: Float64: OTHR_INSRNC_PD_AMT. Amount paid by insurance other than Medicare or Medicaid on the claim.
content.othr_tp_clctn_cd: String: OTHR_TP_CLCTN_CD. Other third-party collection code.
content.fundng_cd: String: FUNDNG_CD. Funding code associated with the claim.
content.fundng_src_non_fed_shr_cd: String: FUNDNG_SRC_NON_FED_SHR_CD. Code for the non-federal share funding source associated with the claim.
content.da_run_id: Float64: DA_RUN_ID. Identifier for the CCW data run used in file production.
content.tmsis_run_id: Float64: TMSIS_RUN_ID. Identifier for the T-MSIS state data processing run that produced the source data.
content.ip_vrsn: String: IP_VRSN. Inpatient version number representing the iteration of the file.
content.ip_fil_dt: Date32[day]: IP_FIL_DT. Inpatient file date representing the year and month of the reporting period.
content.ccw_ld_dt: Date32[day]: CCW_LD_DT. Date the source file was loaded into the CCW.
content.prsn_clm_ind: Float64: PRSN_CLM_IND. Indicator related to person-claim status in the claims file.
content.fed_srvc_ctgry_cd: String: FED_SRVC_CTGRY_CD. Federally assigned service category code added during TAF production to classify claims consistently across files and payment types.
content.dgns_1_ccsr_ctgry_cd: String: DGNS_1_CCSR_CTGRY_CD. CCSR category assigned to the first diagnosis code on the claim.
content.blg_prvdr_nppes_txnmy_cd: String: BLG_PRVDR_NPPES_TXNMY_CD. Billing provider NPPES taxonomy code derived by CMS from the provider NPI and NPPES.
content.filename: String: FILENAME. Likely a local provenance field storing the source file name.
content.year: Int64: YEAR. Likely a local partition or reporting year field maintained outside the IP header codebook schema.
